terms.definition: An AI-native semantic language and intermediate representation for constructing, inspecting, validating, repairing and transporting physically meaningful 3D objects.
The accepted program text and pinned dependencies that authoritatively define supported object meaning and source identity.
Structured normalized records between accepted source and destination tools that preserve declared object meaning within supported contracts.
The structural parent/child relationship between objects, distinct from following and a mechanical connection.
An explicit relationship defining a child frame from a parent frame and a constant rigid offset within the selected observation profile.
A mechanical relation naming two ordered endpoint sites, a signed basis axis, angular limits and an initial coordinate within C260.
A field read from an artifact, with its exact location, whose asserted source meaning is not independently verified by extraction alone.
Facts independently derived from supplied source bytes under the selected observation contract, separate from artifact metadata claims.
Evidence that a named evaluator or capability satisfies its selected finite contract; a component pass does not establish broader product or comparative success.
Admission of a reviewed bounded increment to actual main after its applicable checks, with resulting-main verification and explicit limitations.
Acceptance of a named supported scope after its complete adopted release obligations, distinct from a development branch merge or a partial demonstration.
A durable record of scope, code identity, executed tests, unmet gates, ownership and the exact continuation action.

capabilities.name: Versioned source authoring and repair
capabilities.description: Create, inspect and atomically revise accepted source through explicitly versioned Agent interfaces.
capabilities.limits: Support is profile-specific. This map is navigation and does not rerun or extend any release evidence.

capabilities.name: Raw GLB hinge observation
capabilities.description: Extract C261 hinge metadata claims and their actual JSON pointers from bounded GLB bytes.
capabilities.limits: Untrusted artifact interface only; no source agreement, accepted revision, complete C260 H group, or execution authority.

capabilities.name: Independent source hinge observation
capabilities.description: C265 independently derives finite hinge declarations, ordered site associations, literal values and UTF-8 witnesses from supplied source bytes under C260.
capabilities.limits: Source-only finite profile, including explicit unsupported bare-CR line comments; no artifact agreement, historical admission, site-pose evaluation, full source validity or accepted-revision authority.

capabilities.name: Hinge source/artifact comparison
capabilities.description: C267 compares finite source-derived hinge fields, complete joint sets and ordered endpoint associations after C266 input binding.
capabilities.limits: Finite declaration agreement only. Historical admission, site poses/world behavior, full validity, accepted revisions, execution and comparative claims remain unqualified; omitted top-level metadata stays unobserved.

capabilities.name: Historical hinge input admission
capabilities.description: Admit the exact historical source and artifact inputs through the separate C260 boundary.
capabilities.limits: A raw reader artifact hash does not establish historical source binding or an authentic accepted revision.

capabilities.name: Localized-repair evaluator qualification
capabilities.description: Qualify inert observations for the public keyed-rack family through the C253 protocol and bounded observation components.
capabilities.limits: Complete semantic, source/rebuild, native/model trial and comparative-benefit claims are not established by component results.

capabilities.name: Local development validation
capabilities.description: Execute proportionate repository checks and retain revision-bound evidence in the available assistant workspace.
capabilities.limits: Requires actual execution tools. Missing compatibility, external roles and unrun visual checks remain unverified; no automatic or paid hosted jobs.

capabilities.name: Reusable planar reach actions
capabilities.description: Retain the adopted finite two-hinge reach profile and its outstanding release obligations.
capabilities.limits: Incomplete reference profile; further work requires a selected semantic-authoring or interoperability need.

capabilities.name: Source/program/object input binding
capabilities.description: C266 checks the retained artifact source and program identity and complete repeated object provenance against independently derived source facts.
capabilities.limits: Input association only; no hinge-field/set/endpoint comparison, historical admission, omitted module/scene/collection metadata or broader validity claim.
